build_solov2_detector: build a SOLOv2 instance segmentation model with a backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head config
extract_feat_solov2: extract multi-level feature tensors from input images using the SOLOv2 backbone and neck
loss_solov2: compute the training loss for SOLOv2 instance segmentation given input images and ground truth data samples
predict_solov2: run SOLOv2 inference to predict instance masks, bounding boxes, labels, and scores on input images
review_solov2_init: review the SOLOv2 class __init__ to understand how backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head are wired together
